fields.statement: QA cycle 2 at cb434652: built this branch's rhiza (go build -trimpath) and ran it in a scratch repo with a bare origin and a gh shim whose 'run view --log-failed' prints real logs fetched with gh from dphaener/nebari's failed Actions runs. Each head: first ship check --settled --json reran run 42, the second listed tests and findings. Run 42339573426 (nebari#72) gave ['rspec ./spec/views/tasks/list_spec.rb:290']; run 42331018773 gave ['rspec ./spec/system/garden_location_spec.rb[1:1:11]'] and run 42329799773 gave ['rspec ./spec/system/climate_profile_spec.rb[1:1:6]', 'rspec ./spec/system/garden_location_spec.rb[1:1:11]'], closing bracket kept, so cycle 1's id-form defect is fixed; each with one finding per test and no '# ...' comment text, and ship check --test-failures exited 0. gh-prefixed synthetic logs: Minitest gave 'bin/rails test test/models/x_test.rb:12', pytest 'FAILED tests/test_x.py::test_y - AssertionError' gave 'pytest tests/test_x.py::test_y' (both --test-failures exit 0); a Jest 'FAIL src/x.test.js' plus '1 failure' log and an infra-only 'Error: Process completed with exit code 1.' log gave no tests, and --test-failures exited 1 with 'no failing test was recorded for the head: an infra or unparsable failure.'
